description: Re-scan one file on this computer and report whether a finding is gone. Use it right after fixing something yof_check, yof_check_diff or yof_fix_prompt pointed to; it reads only that file, so run yof_check_diff afterwards to cover the rest of the change. With no rule_id it looks for every key rule (secret.*); a package rule needs package and asks npm, PyPI and OSV unless offline is true. A missing file, or one over 1 MB, counts as fixed. Returns file, rule, fixed (true, false, or null when a registry did not answer), why, and for key rules the matches still there, redacted.

file.description: The file to re-scan, relative to the project root.

offline.description: true skips the npm, PyPI and OSV lookups, so nothing leaves this computer; package problems are then not reported. Default false.

package.description: The package name. Required when rule_id is a package rule (package.*).

rule_id.description: The rule id to look for, for example secret.stripe_live. Default: every key rule.

name: yof_verify

fixed.description: true when gone, false when still there, null when a registry did not answer.

reminder.description: For a removed key: replace it at the provider too.

rule.description: The rule checked, or null for every key rule.

still.description: Key matches still in the file (key rules).

title: Verify a fix
